bundle.shortDescription: Run Claude Code and Codex agents on a server you host
bundle.longDescription: Floq is a desktop workspace for running Claude Code and Codex agents on a self-hosted runtime. Organize agents, notes and secrets on a canvas, group them into projects, and review agent actions before they run.
